body:
Looks great!

For future reference, with this PR we are still ignoring the [rendering/shader_compiler/shader_cache/strip_debug](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_projectsettings.html#class-projectsettings-property-rendering-shader-compiler-shader-cache-strip-debug) and [rendering/shader_compiler/shader_cache/compress](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_projectsettings.html#class-projectsettings-property-rendering-shader-compiler-shader-cache-compress) project settings. Dario and I discussed and agreed that for 4.5 the best approach was to restore the 4.4 behaviour as much as possible. 

In 4.4 we always compressed shaders, but we never stripped debug info. For 4.5 we chose to strip debug info by default since not doing so will make baked shaders way too large to be useful. As a workaround for debugging developers can use `--generate-spirv-debug-info` to avoid stripping debug info (as well as generate other useful debug info).
